added.summary: A ::before or ::after content's alternative text, the list after / of strings, counter()s and attr()s (CSS Generated Content 3 §1.2), is what the accessibility tree reads in place of what it draws: `content: "★" / "Featured"` reads Featured. An empty one, `/ ""`, marks the content decorative and leaves it unread. The drawn content is unchanged. A / followed by a quote, an image or nothing is refused.
